scientific_limitations: The classification assumes real parameters with \(a\), \(b\), and \(c\) all nonzero and sets \(d=0\).
The further degenerate cases \(a=0\), \(b=0\), or \(c=0\) are not classified.
No existence claim is made for periodic, quasiperiodic, or chaotic invariant sets at \(d=0\), and no claim is made against the source numerics with \(d>0\).
title: Two equilibria at the zero-dissipation boundary of the Liu–Wu–Fu scroll flow
